text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's Air Shakur. Everyone has their
eye on her as
the most likely winner for
the Hopeful Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: She certainly doesn't look very "hopeful." I wonder what it is she wants.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur hasn't exactly endeared
herself to the
fans since her debut, but
she has been attracting
more and more
attention from them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And whatever they say about her, she's

completely unaffected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Closing this seven-centimeter gap'll
snuff out
the noise.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No matter who's lookin' at 'em, numbers
are a
clear, objective proof that anyone
can
understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The simulation went perfectly. Now I just
have to
recreate the same conditions...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I don't think the data you brought me's
gonna
have much bearing on the results,
though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've been wondering what she did with the data I gave her on unquantifiable influences, but it looks like she is using it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If people want to take up all the oxygen
in the
room makin' noise, then I'll just
keep
brainstorming solutions till the very
last second.
